## Description

Steps Organisation → Facilities → SSO → HIS connection → Record authority → Pilot go-live. Per facility choose Medvya EMR or Existing HIS; statuses "HIS authoritative · write-back on" / "Medvya authoritative" / "HIS not connected yet"; mixed-authority warning; sets ENCOUNTER.authority_mode.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Authority is set per facility and stamped on every new encounter.
- [ ] **AC2.** With HIS authority, chart items show "Synced from HIS" and Medvya never creates a second authoritative chart.
- [ ] **AC3.** Mixed authority shows the attention banner and cross-facility views show source badges.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
